scope: Live UI and isolated cloned catalog/presentation. No purchase or fulfillment calls.

checks.name: Eight cards resolve the authoritative catalog definitions
Every card has editable TMP title/price/rewards and separate Images
Displayed sprites do not use old baked product panels
Four reusable product prefabs and section header exist
Cloned product edit updates title, badge and visible reward numbers
Zero reward rows disappear and skill title has no stale x-count
Unknown store metadata uses the catalog fallback price
Real store metadata overrides fallback, including another currency
Gold currency never displays store metadata
Added products appear without editing the scene
Catalog order controls rendered card order
Removed product becomes unpurchasable then disappears
Null list entries are ignored by the presenter
Presentation title and reward labels update independently of economics
Section order and titles are live presentation fields
Shared skin change reaches each corresponding card
Owned No Ads is disabled and shows the presentation label
Global pending lock disables every live card and unlocks safely
